scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
Congratulations.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[超魔導士]
恭喜。
向勇士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
We High Wizards have
the responsibility of
using our destructive magic
for the right purposes.
scripts.translation:
[超魔導士]
我們超魔導士有責任，將破壞性的魔法用於正道。

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
A lifetime of training
is required before becoming
a High Wizard. Can you imagine
what would happen if our power
was placed in the wrong hands?!
scripts.translation:
[超魔導士]
成為超魔導士，需要一生的修煉。
你能想像，這份力量若落入惡人之手，會發生什麼嗎？！

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
It is time.
And Midgard has
need of those who can
wield the strongest of magic...
scripts.translation:
[超魔導士]
時機已到。
米德加爾特需要能駕馭最強魔法的人...

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
Would you like to
become a High Wizard?
scripts.translation:
[超魔導士]
你願意成為超魔導士嗎？

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honors to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[超魔導士]
準備好了，隨時回來吧。
向勇士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[超魔導士]
你還有可以學習的技能。
請用完剩餘的技能點，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
Congratulations.
As a High Wizard,
I hope use you use
your powers to bring
peace to the oppressed.
scripts.translation:
[超魔導士]
恭喜。
願你身為超魔導士，用自己的力量為受壓迫的人帶來和平。

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[超魔導士]
歡迎來到榮耀之廳——英靈殿。

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[超魔導士]
在這裡安心休息吧。
向勇士們致敬！
